name: OpenCut
watermark: Unconfirmed: the official site and README do not state export watermarking
bestFor: Privacy-minded editors who want a free, open-source alternative
notFor: Anyone who needs a mature editor with documented export limits today
limits: Early beta. The README says it is being rewritten; the currently usable build is opencut-classic, and detailed feature/export limits are not documented (unconfirmed). The README describes web, desktop, and mobile targets.
